name: Layla Eco
description:
Layla is an environmental sensor platform for homes, rentals, and multi-family properties. The Layla connector lets you ask Claude about your properties in natural language, air quality (IAQ, CO2, TVOC), temperature, humidity, noise, barometric pressure, room occupancy, and recent notifications — across every property on your account.

Five read-only tools: list properties, list devices, get time-series sensor readings, list notifications, and view your profile. All read-only by design — Claude cannot change device settings, disable devices, or modify anything on your account through this integration.

Prerequisites: an active Layla account with at least one paired sensor. Common uses: check overnight air quality in a bedroom, review recent alerts across rental properties, spot noise or occupancy spikes, verify sensor coverage during onboarding.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Layla Eco to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Layla Eco to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.laylaelectric.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Layla Eco MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Layla Eco provides these MCP tools: get_device_values, get_self, list_devices, list_notifications, and list_properties.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Layla Eco?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Layla Eco in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.

_published_faq.name: Does Layla Eco MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Layla Eco requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Layla Eco is developed by Layla Eco. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
